# AI Video Agent — Codex + FastH3

## Complete project workflow
Open **AI Video Agent** in ComfyUI's sidebar. Create a project and scene, paste your script, identify reference slots, supply the actual images/voices, then plan clips. Edit and approve each clip before rendering. Completed videos and last frames are saved; Codex inspects the actual last frame before preparing the following prompt.

## Canvas nodes
The upper row runs Codex reference discovery by default. Change operation to **plan clips** for clip planning. `reference_manifest` has one entry per supplied image in the same order, e.g. `[{"id":"actor","name":"Actor","kind":"character","description":"Supplied identity"}]`. Use `[]` without images.

The lower row is muted initially. Enable the Codex prompt pair only when you want to write/revise a target prompt; connect the preceding frame and provide target context. For full saved generation, copy the four values from **Canvas node IDs / review key** below the reviewed clip into **Generate Reviewed Clip**, unmute that node, then queue it once. It queues the actual H3 graph as a separate job. Changes or a new take invalidate the old key.

Planning uses the Codex installation signed in with ChatGPT on your Windows PC or Mac. Download the desktop helper from https://github.com/pareekshit28/ai-video-agent/releases/tag/helper-v0.9.0 and paste this pod’s HTTPS ComfyUI URL into it. The app connects automatically; paste a new URL to switch pods. Keep the app open while planning. Model selection can stay blank to use your computer’s default. The helper connects outbound over HTTPS; your Codex login stays on your computer. H3 still needs its existing 32B conditioning encoder below; it is used only for rendering.

## Model downloads
Download to the listed **ComfyUI/models/** subfolder on your pod. The metadata also includes these links for ComfyUI's model manager. Reuse any H3 files already on your pod.

- **diffusion_models/fasth3_omniref_8step_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors**: [Direct download](https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastH3-OmniRef-Comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/fasth3_omniref_8step_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

- **text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors**: [Direct download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

- **vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors**: [Direct download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors)

- **vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors**: [Direct download](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

## Pod terminal download commands
Set `COMFYUI_DIR` to your actual installation, then run:

```bash
export COMFYUI_DIR=/workspace/ComfyUI
mkdir -p "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/diffusion_models"
curl -fL -C - "https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastH3-OmniRef-Comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/fasth3_omniref_8step_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors" -o "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/diffusion_models/fasth3_omniref_8step_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors"
mkdir -p "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/text_encoders"
curl -fL -C - "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors" -o "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors"
mkdir -p "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/vae"
curl -fL -C - "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors" -o "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors"
mkdir -p "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/vae"
curl -fL -C - "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors" -o "$COMFYUI_DIR/models/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors"
```

Refresh ComfyUI after downloading. Use a recent ComfyUI build with native MiniMax H3 support. This workflow preserves your FastH3 model/attention settings. Live GPU execution must be verified on your pod.
